name: Option profile
reader_question: How do two to four options differ on the same five facts?
relationship: Side-by-side description of options on a fixed set of structured fields; no scoring.
use_when: A small set of options is compared on instrument, status, timing, conditions and open questions
Every cell can be stated in under about 60 characters
avoid_when: Options need grading against criteria — use criterion-matrix
Facts are long-form or differ by option — write a source dossier instead

data_contract.type: announcement | authorization | binding | drawdown | expenditure | operational

data_contract.notes: Timing; start must not follow end
Conditions attached; open question, or 'None stated'

units: No quantities. Dates are ISO and shown verbatim.

editable: Native table: every cell, fills, column widths

table_alternative: The pattern is itself the table; for four-plus options use a long-format table with one row per option.
limitations: Character limits keep every row on a fixed height
Facts are as stated by the source; the table does not rank options

excluded_alternatives.reason: Weights and totals are synthetic scores the tracker does not produce
Unaligned prose hides which fields are missing
